name: U10 M8,5 (u10b_m85_sig0.1_s2)
arch:
A one-layer recurrent network with ReLU and no biases. It reads a sequence of 5 real numbers, one per step, into a hidden state of 8 units, and outputs 5 numbers read from the final state.
  h_0 = 0;  h_t = relu(x_t * W_x + h_(t-1) @ W_h)   W_x: 1 x 8, W_h: 8 x 8
  out = h_5 @ W_o                                   W_o: 8 x 5
112 parameters. The output is a score per class; the network's decision is the largest.
context: The inputs are independent standard-normal numbers. Output class i stands for position i of the sequence (0-based).

tensor_desc.W_h: recurrent weights (row = from unit, column = to unit)
tensor_desc.W_o: readout (row = hidden unit, column = output class)

domain.text: The network is used on sequences of 5 independent standard-normal numbers (a fixed sample of 8000).

tensors.name: W_h
tensors.desc: recurrent weights (row = from unit, column = to unit)

tensors.name: W_o
tensors.desc: readout (row = hidden unit, column = output class)
